Pazapa English Programme for Adults Discover the Situation

Asking for Directions

You are settling into your new neighbourhood. Sometimes you need to ask a neighbour how to get to a nearby place, like the pharmacy or the supermarket.

By the end of this activity, you will recognise words and expressions for asking and giving simple directions.

See how people use this English

Read the short conversation between two neighbours.

AminaExcuse me, where is the pharmacy?
LinaGo straight. Turn left at the corner.
AminaIs it far?
LinaNo, it's next to the supermarket.
AminaThank you for your help.
